description:
The goal of this task is to identify and mark the highest daily closing price of SPY (S&P 500 ETF) for the entire year of 2023.

NinjaTrader 8 is running on the Windows desktop with real historical daily data for SPY pre-imported (covering 2023-2024). Note that the current simulated date is in 2026, so you must configure the chart to load historical data going back to Jan 1, 2023.

Your instructions:
1. Open a new Daily chart for SPY.
2. Configure the Data Series to ensure 2023 data is loaded and visible.
3. Analyze the chart to find the highest closing price of the year 2023.
4. Use the Horizontal Line drawing tool to place a line exactly at this price level.
5. Use the Text drawing tool to place a label "2023 High" near the line.
6. Save the workspace.
7. Create a text file at 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\NinjaTraderTasks\spy_2023_high.txt' containing only the numeric price value (e.g., 400.50).
